name: MUSTAMAIJA
description: Mustamaija is a Finnish card game whose name translates to 'Black Maria'. It is a beating game of the multiple attack type where the aim is to avoid being left holding the Queen of Spades when all other players have run out of cards. Though often considered a children's game, the tactical play is interesting enough for adults to enjoy.

content.text: Mustamaija is a Finnish card game whose name translates to 'Black Maria'. It is a beating game of the multiple attack type where the aim is to avoid being left holding the Queen of Spades when all other players have run out of cards. Though often considered a children's game, the tactical play is interesting enough for adults to enjoy.
Mustamaija originated in Finland. The name refers to the Queen of Spades, which is the 'losing' card. Despite the similar name, it is not related to the British game Black Maria (a Hearts variant).

Two to six players use a standard 52-card pack. Deal and play are clockwise. One player is the attacker and the player to their left is the defender; these roles shift as cards are beaten or picked up. The loser is the player left holding the Queen of Spades when all others have run out of cards.
Standard 52-card deck. Ranking: A (high), K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 (low).
5 cards to each player (3 or 6 in some variants). Remaining cards form the talon. Turn up top card to determine trump suit (usually cannot be Spades).

items.text: Three-Card Variant: Each player dealt 3 cards instead of 5, allowing 2-8 players.
Six-Card Variant: Each player dealt 6 cards.
Fixed Trump: Diamonds always trumps, or King-Queen marriage declares trumps.
